mgmt_bio.text: Flavio Cattaneo, born 27 June 1963 in Rho, Italy, graduated in architecture from the Polytechnic University of Milan and specialized in business finance and real estate management at SDA Bocconi. He was general manager of RAI from 2003 to 2005, CEO of Terna from 2005 to 2014 and chair of Terna Participacoes from 2007 to 2011, CEO of Telecom Italia from 2016 to 2017, and CEO and later executive vice chair of Italo-NTV. Enel's board appointed by the shareholders meeting of 12 May 2026, chaired by Paolo Scaroni, confirmed him in both roles. He was made Cavaliere del Lavoro in 2011.
